notes.title: Version 5.1 Minor Tweaks
notes.content:
Version 5.1 is here and adds a couple of things

- For every 10 Wacky Peaches collected you'll now get a 1up!
- A little 1up animation plays when a 1up is earned
- Added what level you are currently on to the UI to help out with the achievement
- Other internal changes that impacted performance (minorly but still)
- Removed 60FPS cap, frames are now unlimited (FPS cap settings will be added in version 6)

notes.title: The final update
notes.content:
The final Situation TARFU update is here, 

New art, an options menu and a new character can all be found in Situation TARFU version 4!

Now with this done CrazyLegends Studios is moving onto something new and BIG!

Thank you for playing [b]Situation TARFU[/b]
